name: Apple Aqua
summary: Translucent blue gel buttons, pinstripe backgrounds, glossy droplets and brushed-metal windows. It came with Mac OS X in 2000 and made the screen look like water and candy.

philosophy.core_thesis: The screen is a liquid, tactile surface: every control is a glossy drop that invites a click.
design_principles: Make buttons pill-shaped (radius 999px) with a vertical gradient of 2 to 3 stops and a white gloss highlight on the top 45%.
Use a pinstripe background of 2px horizontal lines at 4% opacity on #EDEDED.
Use Aqua blue (#2A6FB8 to #A8D4FF) as the accent and keep other colours below 20% of the surface.
Give each panel an inner highlight (1px white at 80%) and an outer 1px border of #8E8E8E.
Set a soft drop shadow of 0 2px 6px at 30% black under windows and buttons.
Draw icons as glossy, 3D, high-detail objects at 48px or larger with a reflection.
Set text in a humanist sans-serif at 13px to 16px; titles are centred in the title bar.
anti_patterns: Flat fills with no gradient or gloss
Dark themes with matt black surfaces
Text on gel with contrast below 4.5:1

layout.grid_mechanics: Windows and panels on a 4px grid; a title bar of 22px to 28px with three round buttons; panel margins of 12px to 20px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25% to 35% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 12, 20 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: Titles centred in bars; controls flush left in groups; windows stack and overlap by 8px to 24px.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded rectangles of 6px to 10px for windows; pills (999px) for buttons; round buttons of 12px to 16px.

font_pairings.note: A rounded humanist that stands in for Lucida Grande.
A neutral humanist face for body text.
A round display face for titles.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set window titles at 13px, centred, in regular weight.
Put a drop shadow of 0 1px 0 white at 60% under dark text on grey.

color.palette_structure: Aqua blue and pinstripe grey, with graphite and a lime or red signal for status buttons.
color.contrast_rules: Graphite on pinstripe holds at least 10:1; white text on Aqua holds at least 4.5:1 at 16px bold.
color.surface_treatment: Glossy gel: a vertical 2 to 3 stop gradient with a white highlight on the top half.
color.light_and_shadow: Light from the top; highlights of white at 60% to 80% on top edges; shadows fall down by 2px to 6px.

materiality.surface_simulation: Water, glass and brushed metal, drawn with gradients and reflections.
materiality.border_rules: 1px solid border in a darker tone of the fill (for example #2A6FB8 on Aqua).
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Soft shadow 0 2px 6px at 30%; inner highlight 1px white at 80%; no blur of the background.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Glossy, volumetric icons with a reflection at 48px or larger; small UI icons are solid glyphs with a gel dot.
ornamentation_details.illustration: 3D rendered objects with water-like transparency and highlights.

motion.transition_physics: Fluid, liquid motion: windows genie-scale into the dock, buttons pulse with a slow 1.5s Aqua glow when default.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the gel highlight by 10%; active state darkens the gradient by 15% and moves the highlight down by 2px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that the screen is friendly, tactile and delightful.

use_cases: app landing pages with a friendly tone
avoid_when: The product is a dense professional tool.
The brand needs a flat, modern look.
The page must be light for accessibility or low-power screens.

modifiers.how: Remove the gloss and gradient; keep the blue and the radius.
Add leather, wood and stitching textures and deeper shadows.
Add sky and grass backgrounds, bubbles and a lighter palette.

pack.why: A solid, soft-cornered family with volume that matches the glossy, filled look of gel controls.

ground.why: Aqua windows sit on fine grey pinstripes, with a glow of blue light under them.
